name: Search Boards
description: Searches for boards matching the specified query. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-search/#api-search-get).

configurable_props.name: query
configurable_props.label: Query
configurable_props.description: The search query with a length of 1 to 16384 characters

configurable_props.name: idOrganizations
configurable_props.label: Organization IDs
configurable_props.description: Specify the organizations to search for boards in

configurable_props.name: partial
configurable_props.label: Partial Search?
configurable_props.description: Specifying partial to be true means that Trello will search for content that starts with any of the words in `query`. When searching for an object titled "My Development Status Report", by default a solution is to search for "Development". If partial is enabled, a search for "dev" is possible, however, a search for "velopment" is not possible.

configurable_props.name: boardFields
configurable_props.label: Boards Fields
configurable_props.description: `all` or a list of board [fields](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/guides/rest-api/object-definitions/#board-object) to be returned in the results

configurable_props.name: boardsLimit
configurable_props.label: Boards Limit
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of boards to return.
